1. Next.js project scaffolded with TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, App Router, src-dir, `@/*` import alias
2. Prisma + @prisma/client installed, SQLite datasource configured
3. shadcn/ui initialized with defaults

5. vitest + @vitejs/plugin-react installed

   - Category: id, name, parentId, description, createdAt, updatedAt, self-relation for tree
   - Item: all 20+ fields including code (unique), name, sn, model, manufacturer, categoryId, unit, quantity, safetyStock, position, supplier, price, warrantyStart, warrantyEnd, nandType, compatibleProducts, relations to Category/Transaction/StockTake

8. Prisma migration run (db push) and client generated
9. Prisma client singleton in `src/lib/prisma.ts`
10. vitest config with `@/` alias and node environment
11. Root layout with Chinese metadata, globals.css with Tailwind directives

- Project scaffolded with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, App Router

- shadcn 4.7.0 initialized, 15 components added (form was not available — noted)
- Prisma schema created with all 4 models
- Database pushed and client generated
- Prisma singleton created with PrismaBetterSqlite3 adapter
- vitest config created
